name: valdane-rail-retrieval-v1
author: Pyae Sone (Seon), repo author
note: Authored for this repo, not a public benchmark. Twenty questions over the fictional corpus in corpus.json, written before any results were generated. single-hop: the answer sits in one chunk that shares words with the question. multi-hop: the answer needs a second chunk reached through a bridging entity (for example a train series) that the question does not name.

items.question: Who chairs the board of the Valdane Transport Authority?

evidence.contains: opened in its current form in 2011
